mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, sku_code, spec_info, price, original_price, stock, image, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{specInfo}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_id = VALUES(product_id), spec_info = VALUES(spec_info), price = VALUES(price), original_price = VALUES(original_price), stock = VALUES(stock), image = VALUES(image), status = VALUES(status), update_time = NOW(), deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0
